name: Phantasmal Combat
body:
School illusion (phantasm)) [mind-affecting]; Level bard 3, sorcerer/wizard 4, witch 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Area 20-ft.-radius spread
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You create phantasmal sensations of a pitched battle in the area. Any who enter the area must make a Will save or be affected by the phantasm). You and any creatures that succeeded on their Will saves see shadowy shapes, all other creatures do not see anything.

Creatures that failed their Will saves move cautiously and try to avoid the dangers of the battle. They cannot make attacks of opportunity and are considered flanked by any creature attacking them. If the creature leaves the area, they are no longer affected and do not perceive the battle. If they re-enter the area, they are allowed another Will save to disbelieve the phantasm).

When casting the spell, you can designate a number of allies that are immune to the spell and can see its shadowy presence equal to your caster level.
